```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/maple-mono@5.2.5/index.min.css">
<script src="https://unpkg.com/lucide@latest/dist/umd/lucide.min.js"></script>

<div class="ing-outer">
 <div class="ing-header">
  <div class="ing-header-icon"><i data-lucide="git-compare"></i></div>
  <span class="ing-header-text">Two Icons: Random vs. Deterministic</span>
 </div>
 <div class="ing-grid">
  <div class="ing-card">
   <img class="ing-img" src="resources/cooking-oil.png" alt="Cooking oil icon">
  </div>
  <div class="ing-card">
   <img class="ing-img" src="resources/light-soy-sauce.png" alt="Light soy sauce icon">
  </div>
 </div>
 <div class="ing-note">
  Everything <strong>deterministic</strong> is shared: the bottle, the cork, the framing, and the label text composited on afterward. Only the liquid, the part left <strong>random</strong>, differs in color and texture.
 </div>
</div>

<script>
  if (typeof lucide !== 'undefined') lucide.createIcons();
</script>
```
